name: nuclear receptor coactivator 1
pathways: mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NCOA1 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include MEIS1::NCOA1/2 primitive spindle cell sarcoma; Uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
